features.description: When the visitor's participant leaves and does not return within the grace, the session journals visitor_left, runs its closing work (final extraction, visit summary, final concierge.memory) while the room is still connected, and ends with reason 'visitor left'.
steps: concierge/session_end.py has `async def end_session(...)` (the plan's signature) that runs once per session, guarded so a second call (from on_shutdown, or the cap and the departure racing) does nothing beyond what is left: cancel the cap timer and the DepartureWatcher, compactor.aclose(), writer.flush() (the final extraction), write_summary unless erased or no user turn, journal session_ended with {reason, duration_s}, then one more concierge.memory via publisher.final(current_memory(...)), then ctx.shutdown(reason); on_shutdown in concierge/session.py calls the same function (the room is gone by then, so its publish attempt is skipped or dropped and logged by type) and still closes the store last

concierge/session.py starts a DepartureWatcher(ctx.room, f'visitor-{info.visitor_id}', on_left) right after ctx.connect() for every session that has a room (the capped session too); on_left journals visitor_left {grace_s} then awaits end_session('visitor left'); the time-limit path (start_session_timer / say_and_end with end=...) and the daily-cap path end through end_session too, so the final concierge.memory goes out before the agent leaves; the forget_me path is unchanged (erased: no summary, the empty memory is already the last)

tests/test_session.py (the `fakes` fixture: a real AgentSession over FakeLLMs, a FakeRoom as ctx.room, DEPARTURE_GRACE_S monkeypatched to 0.1): test_visitor_leaving_ends_the_session_after_the_grace asserts ctx.shutdown was called once with reason 'visitor left', exactly one visitor_left journal row and one session_ended row with reason 'visitor left', in that order; test_visitor_returning_within_the_grace_keeps_the_session asserts no shutdown and no visitor_left row after 3x the grace; test_another_participant_leaving_changes_nothing; test_the_final_memory_is_sent_before_shutdown asserts the last concierge.memory body on the FakeRoom was sent before the recorded ctx.shutdown call and validates against tests/contract/memory.schema.json
